name: Carl Sandburg Home, Farm Manager's House
address: Carl Sandburg Home National Historic Site, Flat Rock, Henderson County, NC

location.how: APPROXIMATE, not the building: the barn complex of the Sandburg farm (Connemara Farms on Google's view), between two candidate buildings east of it, from the drawing's site map (sheet 1, building 3 north of the barns, item 4). The farm manager's house could not be told apart on the public ortho (nc-latest 2024) or Google's view (8/21/2023): the candidates are under tree canopy

standing.note: NPS-owned and likely standing, but not identified from above; no change check possible. The 3DEP read failed on this point because the parcel under it is the whole 264-acre site (BASIS-GEO-011, more than 64 tiles). Usable for methods that read the appraisal (M0) only, until the building is placed.

sheets.1: title, history, site map of the Sandburg estate
sheets.2: first floor plan (1/4" = 1'-0") with dimension strings all round, roof line dashed
sheets.3: second floor plan (1/4" = 1'-0"), the half story under the main roof
sheets.5: roof plan (1/4" = 1'-0"), undimensioned, with wall-corner marks
sheets.6: south and north elevations (1/4" = 1'-0"), no levels printed

roof_shape: cross-gable (main gable, ridge east-west, with a lower gabled north wing; shed porch roof on the wing's west side, hipped porch roof on the south)

plan.north: sheet right (E on the sheet). The arrow glyph has the letter N at its left end, but its filled half-head points right, the second-floor plan labels the sheet-top wall WEST WALL and the sheet-bottom wall EAST WALL, and the elevations agree (west elevation sees the wing and its porch on the viewer's left)
plan.note: Start at the main block's sheet-top-left corner, walk clockwise. L-shaped: main block 28'-3" x 34'-10" (sheet left) and the north wing 26'-7" x 14'-0" at its lower right; overall 54'-10" x 34'-10". The wing's sheet-top side carries an open porch (excluded).

chain.label: west wall of the main block (sheet top)

length.note: right string 6'-9" + 3'-0" + 7'-4" + 2'-4" + 1'-5" from the main block's corner to the wing's porch-side wall

wing's west wall, behind the porch
east wall, wing and main block
south wall of the main block (front, behind the porch)

excluded: south front porch (sheet left), 5'-8 1/2" deep x about 25 ft, hipped roof, stone steps beyond
west porch on the wing (sheet top of the wing), about 5'-10" x 25'-11", open on its long side

floors.note: A half story under the main gable with its own walls drawn, the full 34'-10" length of the main block but only 12'-9" wide at the west wall and 12'-5" at the east wall (room widths printed 11'-10"/11'-8" and 11'-6"/11'-5"); the sheet-right wall is slightly skewed (scaled tick positions 4494 vs 4454 px, the left wall straight). Start at the top-left corner, clockwise.

length.note: the printed 34'-10" north-south with the 4" taper (12'-9" vs 12'-5"): hypot(34.833, 0.333), bearing 180 + atan(0.333/34.833)

eave.note: mean of the two passes' scaled readings, 10.15 and 10.15 ft. no levels printed on any elevation. Lower edge of the main roof at sheet y 4490, the drawn grade at 5506 (level along the south front): 1016 px at 100.07 px/ft, calibrated on the main block's wall length 34'-10" = 3486 px on the same elevation. Rafter tails hang to 4531 (9.75 ft). The site falls to the north and east: the wing's eave stands about 17 ft above the drawn grade on the north elevation and about 13 ft on the east.

ridge.note: mean of the two passes, 25.2 and 25.19 ft. top of the main roof (ridge line) at sheet y 2984 over grade 5506: 2522 px at 100.07 px/ft

readings.datum_text: drawn grade at the wing's north end (basement exposed)
drawn grade at the wing's north end

overhang.note: mean of the two passes' scaled readings, 1.0 and 0.95 ft

roof.note: main gable ridge runs east-west (sheet vertical), so the main eaves are the sheet-left (south) and sheet-right (north) sides; the north wing's own eaves face east and west (sheet bottom and top, the top one under the porch shed). The eaves list names the main roof's sides only.
roof.derive_note: L-shaped cross gable of two pitches with porch roofs

b.note: porch floor edge sheet y 2245 to 4745 at 100 px/ft

porches.name: west porch on the north wing

passes.a: pass A: an independent reader of the 400 dpi sheets (2026-11-25), chain and heights read from crops
passes.b: pass B: a second independent reader of the same sheets (2026-11-25), not shown pass A

disagreements.pass_a: identical chain and heights to 0.01 ft

disagreements.resolved: not scored (roof.derive false); the mean 0.975 ft is recorded

flags.note: The window string under the wing's 26'-7" (2'-8" + 3'-0" + 2'-10" + 2'-10" + 3'-8" + 2'-10" + 9'-0") sums to 26'-10", 3" over; by scale the second 2'-10" is 2.67 ft and the 3'-8" 3.58 ft. The chain keeps 26'-7", which the 54'-10" overall confirms.
North arrow glyph is ambiguous (N lettered at the left end, filled head at the right); north = sheet right was fixed from the WEST WALL / EAST WALL labels on sheet 3 and the elevations.
Heights are scaled (no levels printed) on a steep site; the south front is the only side with level grade. Eave above grade ranges about 10 ft (south) to 17 ft (north end of the wing).
